name: codex-live-session
description: Session-scoped mobile bridge for a live Codex Desktop conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Bridge the current Codex conversation to a phone.
interface.longDescription: Starts a temporary session-scoped bridge for one Codex conversation, streams live progress to a phone page, and accepts phone-originated text input for the bound conversation.
defaultPrompt: Start a mobile bridge for this session.
Show me the pairing URL for my phone.
